original_test_intent: Exercise every populated front-side storage device for 12 hours at 0C and +5% 5V/3.3V rails and verify stable, error-free data and device behavior.
original_method: Do not execute until immutable bay-to-serial/WWN/namespace mappings, protected-target exclusions, approved workload/destructive policy and measurable integrity/performance/error criteria are supplied; after resolution, control dew point and high rails, run the complete front-bay set for 12 hours with per-device evidence, then warm safely, clean up and restore nominal state.
manual_activity: After blocker resolution, operator controls dry chamber/high rails and supervises storage stress and warm-up.
required_inputs: SST version and exact read/write/data-set/runtime/concurrency profile
Destructive-write authorization and backup if applicable
Per-device integrity, media, reset, latency/performance and thermal thresholds
0C dew-point/+5% rail limits, abort, cleanup and restoration
safety_requirements: Do not run undefined writes or erase logs
Require disposable/backup proof for destructive targets
Maintain OOB and stop on data/device/electrical/thermal fault
Warm above dew point before chamber opening
agent_execution_scope: May validate supplied identities and analyze captured evidence after resolution
Must not select targets, initiate storage stress or decide verdict
engineer_actions: Define bay population, workload and acceptance oracle
Approve storage safety and environmental profile

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Physical boundary is correct, but undefined front-disk selection is unsafe and cannot prove all-bay coverage.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: No command until identities, exclusions, profile and criteria are approved; then use only pinned SST against approved targets.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All front-side storage, 0C, +5% 5V/3.3V and 12 hours remain required.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a signed target/workload matrix with per-device evidence synchronized to chamber, dew-point and rail data.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds missing target safety, workload semantics, acceptance oracle, condensation controls and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: An arbitrary front disk cannot represent every bay and may expose protected data.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: The Master criteria are only duplicated actions, so elapsed time or a clean-looking console cannot support acceptance.

project_override_considerations: Owner defines target disposability/endurance, concurrent versus sequential coverage, acceptable cold/high-rail performance change and warm-up policy.
expected_evidence: SST binary/config and exact target list
Per-device workload, integrity, SMART/NVMe error/reset and thermal results
Safe warm-up, cleanup and nominal post-health

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Criteria repeat execution actions rather than defining an expected outcome, conflicting with the all-storage validation claim by leaving no acceptance oracle.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Safe target identity, workload semantics and measurable acceptance are irreducibly absent; this is more than a missing package or operator input.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Stability row38 Wistron-Margin-00037-V002: provide every front-bay serial/WWN/namespace/BDF/slot map and protected-target exclusions, approved SST profile/destructive policy, 12-hour per-device integrity/performance/media/reset/thermal thresholds, 0C humidity/dew-point/+5% rail limits, abort, warm-up, cleanup and restoration.

review_improvement: Prevents unsafe undefined disk stress and exposes the missing acceptance contract while preserving all-bay cold/high-rail coverage.
independent_technical_reasoning: Cold conditions and high rails can trigger backplane, link or drive resets that a coarse job may recover from. Without immutable per-bay identities and an oracle, neither complete coverage nor data safety can be demonstrated, and a successful process exit has no approved engineering meaning.
